verdict.rationale: Stripe's Agentic Commerce Suite documents a single seller integration with catalog feeds, agent checkout, SPT payment credentials over ACP/UCP, and per-agent order attribution, so buyers can 'complete purchases without leaving the conversation'; ChatGPT is named as the first ACP platform. Access is gated: the feature is in private preview, seller onboarding needs a waitlist or application, it is limited to certain countries, and it supports physical goods only. Missing for 10: named support for Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peer surfaces; general availability beyond private preview and waitlist; non-physical goods; independent hands-on corroboration of in-chat merchant checkout.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: Buyers can browse products, get personalized recommendations, and complete purchases without leaving the conversation.
Use Agentic Commerce Suite (ACS) to start selling through agents with a single integration.
OpenAI is the first AI platform to implement ACP with ChatGPT
Agentic Commerce Suite is private preview and is available in the US, Canada, and select European countries. It supports purchases of physical goods
Stripe sends `checkout.session.completed` after the agent completes an order.
